name: Doug Stanhope
note: STAGE PERSONA graph for the 'Why is X Funny?' video series. Graph-only. 0 sets measured — all hypothesis. Public persona only, no biography.

identity.deal: Degenerate philosopher who treats civilization as a bar fight he's narrating from the corner stool.
identity.premise: A man who says the thing the room was thinking, then keeps going until the room wishes they hadn't thought it.
identity.awareness_note: Fully aware the nihilism is a pose; the craft is the real philosophy.

philosophy.ontology: Civilization is a bar fight with better lighting.
philosophy.epistemology: If everyone's uncomfortable, you're probably over the target.
philosophy.axiology: Honesty over comfort; the truth is rarely polite.
philosophy.causality: One good deconstruction can collapse a whole room's self-image.
philosophy.agency: Anyone can be offensive; almost nobody is right about why.

dramatic_core.want: to be right about how dark it is
dramatic_core.fear: becoming the thing he's yelling about — the sellout comic
dramatic_core.need: the room to leave more awake than they came
dramatic_core.self_model: a man narrating the collapse from the barstool
blind_spots: the nihilism can become a cage
the darkness can lose the room

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats every social institution as a con, then follows the con until the room is complicit.
contradictions: the nihilist with the biggest heart
the offensive comic with the sharpest analysis
the barfly who became a philosopher

status_model.felt_status: a man permanently outside the room he's in

expression.emotional_restraint: low — the rage is the point
tells: the laugh that is also a cry
